# Codestrand

> Watch Git history take shape over time

## Getting started

- [Installation](https://codestrand.pages.dev/getting-started/installation/): Codestrand ships as a native binary. Choose a channel matching your tools. The guides describe 0.2.0. Until publication, install from `main` for these features. If an option in the guides is missing from `--help`, build from `main`:
- [First use](https://codestrand.pages.dev/getting-started/quickstart/)

## Guides

- [Git history import](https://codestrand.pages.dev/history/)
- [Playback](https://codestrand.pages.dev/playback/): Preview loops the selected history. If playback is still preparing after a minute, the planning status shows a warning and suggests `--start-date YYYY-MM-DD` (inclusive, UTC) when a later start would keep about the last 1,000 tree-changing commits across the selected repositories. If you already set `--start-date`, replace it with the suggested date. Preview keeps planning and clears the warning when playback starts. Export uses a static overview that fits the scene by default.
- [Export](https://codestrand.pages.dev/export/)
- [Config file](https://codestrand.pages.dev/configuration/): `--config FILE` reads `preview` and `export` options from a TOML file, so a run can be kept and repeated as one file. Each key is a flag name without the leading dashes:
- [Contributors and avatars](https://codestrand.pages.dev/contributors/): Preview and export read `contributors.toml` from the user configuration directory:
- [Privacy and local processing](https://codestrand.pages.dev/security/): Codestrand makes no application network requests by default. Git import, planning and rendering run locally; repositories are not uploaded. Avatar fetching is opt-in.
- [Troubleshooting](https://codestrand.pages.dev/troubleshooting/)
- [AI agents](https://codestrand.pages.dev/ai-agents/): Coding agents can run Codestrand for you: inspect a repository, open a preview or export frames and video. This page lists the context Codestrand publishes for them; the rest of these docs cover the CLI itself.
- [Related tools](https://codestrand.pages.dev/related-tools/): Codestrand is inspired by Gource; other Git history visualisers and Gource helpers offer several ways to explore a repository.
